lines.en: Grandma, is this your friend's farm?
Yes. I worked here when I was young.
Really? Look, a cow and a horse!
The pigs are in the barn over there.
Can I see the chickens too?
Sure. Ask the farmer first, please.
What is growing in that field?
Corn. The harvest will come in autumn.
I want to help with the crops!
Good. We will come back and help in autumn.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 그때 다시 와서 도울 거예요.

lines.en: Good morning, Sir. Can we feed the animals?
Sure. The sheep eat grass from your hand.
They are so soft. What do the pigs eat?
They eat old vegetables from the farm.
Last year I fed a horse for the first time.
The horse here loves apples. Try one.
lines.ko: 여기 말은 사과를 좋아해요. 하나 줘 보세요.

lines.en: Where are the chickens?
In the barn. They will lay eggs this afternoon.
lines.ko: 헛간에요. 오늘 오후에 알을 낳을 거예요.

lines.en: The cows look happy. Thank you for your time.
lines.ko: 소들이 행복해 보여요. 시간 내 주셔서 고마워요.

lines.en: You are welcome. Come again at harvest time.
